$comment: KNOWN NOISE, so the rig does not cry wolf. Every entry needs an `expires` date and an `owner`.
Past that date the noise reports as a failure with the note 'noise waiver expired', which is what
stops an allow-list from quietly hiding a real break for a year.
Match is a substring of the request URL plus the exact status. Both must match.
Keep this list SHORT. Anything here is a real defect nobody has fixed yet.

entries.why: Sitewide since before 2026-09-20, on every page including Pokemon. Seven @font-face rules request files that are not in the export. Cosmetic: the fallback face renders. Separate small fix.
Pre-existing and shared with One Piece. The RPC replaced a file that no longer exists; a non-2xx sets an internal failed flag and the card page renders without alternates. Harmless today.

DELIBERATE, not a defect. Pokemon's plaintext catalog is retired from the public bucket and served only as catalog.enc behind the catalog-key edge function. A 400 here is the gate working. Listed so a sweep does not report it, and dated so somebody re-reads this in December.
